title: Anthropic reports Claude contributions to two black-hole physics problems
summary: Anthropic says Claude contributed to two open problems in black-hole physics, including a reported proof of an upper limit on black-hole mass consistent with a given central charge—a result a commenter describes as making the setup a consistent theory of quantum gravity. According to the announcement quoted in discussion, neither result describes our own universe directly and neither has practical applications. The claim comes from a vendor announcement rather than independent validation, and the post, abstracts, and papers reportedly do not state the prompting used.
